fact: CNDP president Omar Seghrouchni wrote to national media outlets asking them to notify processing and request the required authorisations from the CNDP, to bring all processing into line with Law 09-08 before 31 July 2025.
title: السغروشني ينبه المنابر الإعلامية لعقوبات مخالفة قانون حماية المعطيات الشخصية
